summary: Two distinct Repositories through one scoped application, real final-authorization barrier: first StorageFailure, second Completed, one committed row instead of two; watchdog did not fire. SealedObjects diagnostic counts row-referenced directories only, not all unreferenced objects.
correction_boundary: Replace Add+Save with atomic PublishAsync through the existing specific repository and a fresh context per insertion; preserve final authority and noncancellable row linearization. Internal seam within accepted plan, no new architecture or approval trigger.
